source.title: ZESCO extends load shedding to 12 hours a day

text:
ZESCO extends load shedding to 12 hours a day

ZESCO Limited has extended load shedding to 12 hours a day for domestic customers and mines on the Copperbelt. The company said that low water levels at Lake Kariba cut generation at Kariba North Bank.

Mining companies said that they will run diesel generators to keep critical pumps and ventilation fans in operation.
